guard: awaitReadiness still reports a launch failure when backlog throws because waitForExit already closed the attach stream
why: waitForExit closes the controller socket in finally. Readiness onExit then snapshots backlog. Without the catch, that throw leaves the launch hanging until the backstop and reports uncertain, or kills the process as an unhandled rejection.
